articleTitle: When Your Partner Prioritizes His Ex's Kid Over Yours
imageHeadline: He drives 12 hours for his ex's kid but won't let yours visit
imageSubtext: That's not a boundary. It's a choice about what kind of relationship he wants.
pinTitle: When Your Partner Prioritizes His Ex's Child Over Yours – Boundary or Compatibility Issue?
pinDescription: He'll make a 12-hour trip for his goddaughter but keeps your children at arm's length. This asymmetry reveals more than awkwardness—it shows how he sees your kids fitting into his life. Learn how to frame the boundary conversation and recognize when it's not a communication problem, but a values mismatch.

items.label: Name the specific behavior that doesn't work
Ask him to explain the discrepancy
Watch how he responds to the request
Decide if his actions match his words
